mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the GDP growth rate (GDPC1) over the past two quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, which typically leads to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the GDP growth rate declines but S&P 500 forward returns remain positive in more than 60% of instances, or if the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window exceeds 0.05, the hypothesis is rejected.
